note: Derating check: applying the derating policy and finding which parts fail

state.derating_policy: Aluminum electrolytic capacitors: working voltage no more than 80% of rated voltage. Ceramic capacitors (X7R/X5R): DC working voltage no more than 60% of rated. Chip resistors: actual dissipation no more than 50% of rated power. MOSFETs: drain-source voltage no more than 80% of rated, with 25 C junction temperature margin. Above 85 C ambient, reduce each of those limits by a further 10 percentage points.
state.environment: Inside a sealed enclosure, measured max 95 C, running 24 hours a day
state.parts_to_check: C12: MLCC 22 uF / 25 V X7R, actual DC voltage 12 V. C7: aluminum electrolytic 470 uF / 35 V, actual DC voltage 24 V. R31: chip resistor 1 ohm 1 W, actual dissipation 0.62 W. Q3: NMOS, rated Vds 100 V, actual Vds 85 V

all_compliant.instructions: Do all four parts satisfy the derating policy above, including the 95 C ambient correction?

violations.instructions: Which parts violate the derating requirements?

criteria.r31_and_q3: Both the resistor and the MOSFET are over
criteria.only_c7: Only the electrolytic capacitor is over

risk_level.instructions: What is the overall risk level?

criteria.replace_parts: Switch to higher voltage or power rated parts
criteria.change_circuit: Lower the actual voltage or dissipation
criteria.thermal_test: Measure real temperature rise to check the margin
criteria.design_review: An engineer should re-review this section
